hazards.situation: Coincidences are lost, duplicated or altered without being reported
An acquisition fails or stops before its end
Data is recorded with wrong or unidentifiable settings
An unauthorized party controls the acquisition

items.rationale: Makes the data durable with its run record; a defect loses data at a file boundary (HZ-1) or loses the record of how it was acquired (HZ-3).
Accepts commands over TCP; a defect can stop a running scan (HZ-2) or accept commands from anyone who can connect (HZ-4).
Records control actions and harms no one if it fails.

Reference client in its own process; the server validates every request, so a defect in the client can only send a valid command that the server reports back. Process segregation makes class A possible.
Not shipped: measurement programs that never run at the scanner, controlled as tools (Chapter 20).
